Class H3CellSocioDemographicBase

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.database.H3CellSocioDemographicBase
Direct Known Subclasses:
H3Cell
@MappedSuperclass public abstract class H3CellSocioDemographicBase extends Object
Mapped JPA superclass encapsulating cryospheric surface dynamics, coastal engineering flags, extraterrestrial pressurized habitat infrastructure, 7-cohort demographic age pyramids, epidemiological SEIR compartments, and linguistic diffusion state for H3Cell.

All persistent fields in this MappedSuperclass map directly onto the h3_cells_l8 relational table while keeping H3Cell concise and modular.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
